card.text: M12 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 5,110 parsecs away.

sources.label: Baumgardt & Vasiliev (2021), Accurate distances to Galactic globular clusters through a combination of Gaia EDR3, HST and literature data, MNRAS 505, 5957; Baumgardt's orbits table, NGC_6218: Rsun 5.11 ± 0.05 kpc
Wikipedia, "Messier 12"
sources.quote: Messier 12 or M 12 is a globular cluster in the constellation of Ophiuchus.

introduction.text: M12 is drawn as 3,627 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.

sources.quote: It was discovered by the French astronomer Charles Messier on May 30, 1764, who described it as a "nebula without stars".
